requirements: R1: Fix the HTTP 401 errors for authenticated requests on endpoints that must answer 200/201.
R2: Implement Moodle integration including single sign-on (SSO), role synchronization, access control, and offline fallback.

slices.title: Resolve Moodle Integration and API Auth Audit Findings
slices.jtbd: When implementing the follow-up fixes for this epic, I want to resolve the HTTP 401 errors and implement Moodle SSO/role synchronization/offline fallback, so that the self-falsification audit passes.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a valid authenticated request, When it accesses an endpoint requiring 200/201, Then the server responds successfully.
Given a user attempting to log in, When using Moodle credentials, Then SSO authenticates them and synchronizes their roles.
Given a Moodle login failure, When the offline fallback is used, Then the user is granted access based on fallback rules.
